nodes.label: Metadata container — collected into <head>
nodes.rationale: Wraps head elements anywhere in the tree; renderers collect children and inject into <head>. Head children must be static (Title/Meta/Link/Script/StyleEl/Fragment); reactive head content is not collected into the SSR head.

nodes.label: Page(PageMeta) — full SEO/social/JSON-LD constructor
nodes.rationale: Expands a single config into title, OG/Twitter cards, JSON-LD and LLM meta, propagating each field to every relevant format; returns a Fragment so it composes inside Metadata.
